note: Channel audience profiles (PRD Appendix B.1). Editorial context is the field that sharpens generated ad copy — it is the brief handed to the asset studio. Demographic strings and reach figures are placeholders until AMS supplies structured audience research; monthlyReach is deliberately empty rather than invented, and the UI omits the line when it is empty.

channels.name: Iltalehti
channels.whyItFits: Finland's largest news site — the widest general audience available in one place.
channels.editorialContext: News and entertainment mindset. The reader is browsing, emotionally receptive, and open to discovery rather than searching for something specific.

channels.name: Kauppalehti
channels.whyItFits: Finland's business title — reaches decision-makers while they are in a work mindset.
channels.editorialContext: Professional, analytical mindset. The reader is evaluating business decisions and responds to substance, figures, and credibility over emotion.
channels.geographicConcentration: Concentrated in Helsinki-Uusimaa and other growth centres

channels.name: Etuovi
channels.whyItFits: Finland's home marketplace — reaches people already in a moving or renovating mindset.
channels.editorialContext: Actively searching, high intent, specific need. The reader has a task in progress and welcomes anything that helps them finish it.
channels.geographicConcentration: National, strongest where housing turnover is highest
